description: Fictitious delivery minutes: planted linear model plus Gaussian noise (sigma 5).
sizingNote: 6,000 rows (Ruling Q9: >= 5,000). Each beta's OLS SE is about sigma/sqrt(n) = 0.064, so every planted effect is more than 20 SE from zero, and the true model's RMSE (5.01) is far below the mean baseline's (6.41).

extrapolation.rule: rows with any |feature| > 2 (outside +/-2 SD of the N(0,1) feature distributions) form the extrapolation slice; judges score it separately from the interior
